price_basis.drinks: Medium size for made-to-order drinks; one bottle for bottled drinks.
price_basis.food: One typical serving/order unless a count or package is specified.
price_basis.note: Prices are approximate estimates as of November 2026 and vary by location.

restaurant_info.data_confidence: General chain-wide expectations. Details marked 'varies_by_location' should be confirmed for a specific store.

drive_thru.note: Drive-thru is a core part of the Dunkin' model; walk-up/urban and some inside-venue stores (airports, campuses, gas stations) may have none.

indoor.typical: Limited or small seating at many stores; some newer builds are drive-thru focused with minimal or no dining room.

outdoor.typical: Uncommon; patio seating appears at only some locations, mostly suburban.

service_style.delivery: via third-party apps such as DoorDash, Uber Eats and Grubhub (varies by location)

best_for: breakfast on the way to work

study_or_work_spot.reasoning: Fast-turnover stores with small seating areas and a steady stream of drive-thru traffic; better for a quick email session than a long study block.
tips: Off-peak hours (mid-morning to early afternoon) are quieter
Check for outlets and Wi-Fi before settling in
Bring headphones - noise from the drive-thru and equipment is common

wifi.note: Offered at many dine-in stores; often absent at drive-thru-only or kiosk-style stores.

restaurant_info.restrooms: varies_by_location (often customer-accessible at stand-alone dine-in stores; limited in some venues)

typical_hours.typical_close: evening, roughly 8-10 PM; some locations open 24 hours

loyalty_program.name: Dunkin' Rewards
loyalty_program.note: App ordering ties into the rewards program.

dietary_notes.vegan_options: limited (some drinks, plain bagels, toast, with non-dairy milk alternatives)
dietary_notes.allergen_note: Shared equipment across items. Check the official allergen guide if you have a food allergy.
